question: Which institute hosted International Chess Federation (FIDE)-rated Rapid Chess Tournament in March 2024?
solution:

• IIT Madras has a history of organizing significant chess events, highlighting its commitment to fostering a competitive spirit and strategic thinking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIDE (International Chess Federation)**

 
 
• Founded in 1924, FIDE is the international governing body of chess.
 
• It is responsible for organizing world chess championships and regulating international chess competitions.
 
• FIDE's mission is to promote chess globally and ensure fair play and integrity in the game.
 
 
 
• **Rapid Chess**
 
 
• Rapid chess is a form of chess with faster time controls than classical chess.
 
• Each player is typically given 15 to 60 minutes for the entire game.
 
• Rapid chess allows for a more dynamic and exciting game, often leading to unexpected outcomes.
 
 
 
• **IIT Madras**
 
 
• Indian Institute of Technology Madras is one of the premier engineering institutions in India.
 
• Established in 1959, it is known for its excellence in education, research, and innovation.
 
• IIT Madras frequently hosts various national and international events, fostering a vibrant academic and cultural environment.
 
 
 
• **Chess in Education**
 
 
• Chess is used as an educational tool to develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and strategic planning skills.
 
• Many educational institutions incorporate chess into their curriculum to enhance cognitive abilities and concentration among students.
 
• Studies have shown that regular chess practice can improve academic performance and intellectual development.
